verificationScript:
import base64, hashlib, json, pathlib, sys, datetime
root = pathlib.Path.cwd()
evidence = root / 'docs/internal/extensions/native1'
def sha_bytes(b): return hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest().upper()
def sha(p): return sha_bytes(p.read_bytes())
def read(name): return json.loads((evidence / name).read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
def require(ok, message):
    if not ok: raise RuntimeError(message)
def checked_pin(rel, expected, prefix=root):
    p = prefix / rel
    actual = sha(p)
    require(actual == expected, 'byte pin mismatch: ' + str(p))
    return dict(path=str(p.relative_to(root)), bytes=p.stat().st_size, sha256=actual)
require(len(sys.argv) == 5, 'expected binary full/control and contract full/control receipt paths')
binary_name, binary_controls_name, contract_name, contract_controls_name = sys.argv[1:]
manifest = read('BINARY_V3_BUILD_MANIFEST.json')
require((len(manifest['sources']), len(manifest['generatedC']), len(manifest['artifacts'])) == (31,19,3), 'build roster count')
build = root / '.lake/native1/binary-build'
require(sha(build/'build-manifest.json') == sha(evidence/'BINARY_V3_BUILD_MANIFEST.json'), 'current/immutable manifest mismatch')
pins = [checked_pin(p['path'],p['sha256']) for p in manifest['sources']+manifest['generatedC']]
pins += [checked_pin(p['path'],p['sha256'],build) for p in manifest['artifacts']]
pins += [checked_pin('packed_rmq.lib',manifest['cppImportLibrarySHA256'],build)]
prefix = (evidence/'ACCEPTANCE_MATRIX.md').read_bytes()[:28298]
require(len(prefix)==28298 and sha_bytes(prefix)=='0A5D2313CCEC30DE81AAB3B19439247C612CE4B8FC6C19C0BF51F6C3809D103E','frozen requirement prefix mismatch')
checked_pin('docs/internal/extensions/native1/AUDIT_REQUIREMENTS.md','2EEB860936F15D1C189D23C67960B1679DFFF1FF6FEB2DBFE53D018C624CBA60')
checked_pin('docs/internal/extensions/native1/SOURCE_CONTRACT.md','8D9833471C76FD84E7C93E1387A755B063EB3307CD6ABE4B604564FAB6ABE94D')
checked_pin('docs/internal/extensions/native1/FINAL_SOURCE_MATRIX.md','AC9259FB49DC6E0CBCDD83760AFE61FD2E76AC27979B8E2ACCDC17782C9395B5')
case_path=root/'scripts/packed_native_binary_cases.json'
require(sha(case_path)=='2D38A1002C1E8A72DF5E164144EC4E8F5410511F2C585831AEFBBC0D1BD4C637','binary registry hash')
registry=json.loads(case_path.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
require(len(registry['cases'])==109,'109 logical cases')
expected=[]
for c in registry['cases']:
    expected += [c['id']+'/'+consumer for consumer in c['consumers']] if c['kind'] in ('native','ffi-mutation') else [c['id']]
require(len(expected)==214 and len(set(expected))==214,'214 unique expanded cases')
binary=read(binary_name)
require(binary['pass'] and not binary['failure'] and binary['expected']==expected and binary['executed']==expected and [r['id'] for r in binary['results']]==expected,'binary exact executed roster')
require(binary['runnerSha256']==sha(root/'scripts/packed_native_binary_replay.ps1'),'binary executed runner differs')
raw_count=0; ffi_count=0; source_count=0
for r in binary['results']:
    require(r['pass'],'failed binary result '+r['id'])
    if 'raw' in r:
        raw_count+=1
        ffi='mutantExpectedStdout' in r
        field='mutantExpected' if ffi else 'expected'
        raw=r['raw']
        require(not raw['timedOut'] and not raw['outputLimitExceeded'],'raw deadline '+r['id'])
        require(raw['exitCode']==r[field+'Exit'],'raw exit '+r['id'])
        require(base64.b64decode(raw['stdoutBase64'])==r[field+'Stdout'].encode('utf-8'),'raw stdout '+r['id'])
        require(base64.b64decode(raw['stderrBase64'])==r[field+'Stderr'].encode('utf-8'),'raw stderr '+r['id'])
        if ffi:
            ffi_count+=1
            require(r['exactGitRestoration'] and r['baselineArtifactsUnchanged'] and r['sourceBeforeSha256']==r['restoredSourceSha256'],'FFI restoration')
            b=r['baselineObservation']; br=b['raw']
            require(b['pass'] and br['exitCode']==b['expectedExit'],'FFI unchanged baseline')
            require(base64.b64decode(br['stdoutBase64'])==b['expectedStdout'].encode('utf-8'),'FFI baseline stdout')
            require(base64.b64decode(br['stderrBase64'])==b['expectedStderr'].encode('utf-8'),'FFI baseline stderr')
            require(raw['stdoutBase64']!=br['stdoutBase64'],'FFI mutation did not change observation')
    else:
        source_count+=1
        require(r['details']['exactGitRestoration'],'source restoration '+r['id'])
require((raw_count,ffi_count,source_count)==(210,2,4),'binary surface totals')
contract_registry=json.loads((root/'scripts/packed_native_contract_cases.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
require(sha(root/'scripts/packed_native_contract_cases.json')=='6E0C8E5A73F7DE47D14F7298435E7F72F2AC82A5881AEBF3EFFE0388CBF48E2C','contract registry hash')
for p in contract_registry['sources']: pins.append(checked_pin(p['path'],p['sha256']))
contract=read(contract_name)
contract_expected=['baseline']+['field-n%02d'%n for n in range(1,43)]+['public-type-collapse']
require(contract['pass'] and contract['expected']==contract_expected and contract['executed']==contract_expected and len(contract['results'])==44,'44 contract roster')
require(contract['runnerSha256']==sha(root/'scripts/packed_native_contract_replay.ps1'),'contract runner changed')
for r in contract['results']:
    d=r['details']; b=d['producerBinding']
    require(r['pass'] and d['producer']['ExitCode']==0,'contract fresh producer '+r['id'])
    require(b['exactFreshBinding'] and b['freshOutputSha256']==b['beforeConsumerSha256']==b['afterConsumerSha256'],'contract binding '+r['id'])
    require(d['exactGitRestoration'] and d['sharedOleansUnchanged'] and d['originalSourceSha256']==d['restoredSourceSha256'],'contract restoration '+r['id'])
    require(d['consumer']['ExitCode']==0 if r['id']=='baseline' else d['consumer']['ExitCode']!=0,'contract consumer verdict '+r['id'])
    if r['id']!='baseline':
        require(b['freshOutputSha256']!=b['sharedOriginalSha256'] and len(d['matchedDiagnostics'])==1,'fresh negative exact surface '+r['id'])
control_summaries=[]
for name,count in [(binary_controls_name,128),(contract_controls_name,9)]:
    r=read(name)
    require(r['pass'] and len(r['expected'])==count and r['executed']==r['expected'] and [x['id'] for x in r['results']]==r['expected'] and all(x['pass'] for x in r['results']), 'control roster '+name)
    control_summaries.append(dict(path=name,sha256=sha(evidence/name),count=count,startedUtc=r['startedUtc'],completedUtc=r['completedUtc']))
for name in [binary_name,binary_controls_name,contract_name,contract_controls_name]:
    r=read(name)
    for c in r['commands']:
        require(not c.get('TimedOut',False) and not c.get('OutputLimitExceeded',False),'incomplete recorded child '+name)
summary=dict(schema='native1-final-integrity-v1',pass_=True,checkedUtc=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
    sourceGeneratedAndArtifactPins=pins,frozenPrefixSha256=sha_bytes(prefix),binaryLogicalCases=109,binaryExpandedCases=214,
    exactRawByteObservations=raw_count,actualFfiMutantObservations=ffi_count,sourceChallengeCases=source_count,contractCases=44,
    controls=control_summaries,receipts=[dict(path=n,sha256=sha(evidence/n)) for n in sys.argv[1:]],
    verificationScript=pathlib.Path(__file__).read_text(encoding='utf-8'),arguments=sys.argv[1:])
(evidence/'commands/final-integrity.json').write_text(json.dumps(summary,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
print('NATIVE1 FINAL INTEGRITY PASS: 31 source / 19 generated C / 3 artifacts; 109/214 binary + 128 controls; 44 contract + 9 controls; exact raw bytes, fresh binding and restoration')
